summary: This is a package.json file that defines a Node.js project called 'cypress_sandbox' used for testing with Cypress. It specifies two npm scripts for opening and running Cypress tests, and lists Cypress as a development dependency.

explanations.6: This creates an npm script named 'cypress:open' that runs the command 'cypress open', which launches the Cypress interactive test runner in your browser.
explanations.7: This creates an npm script named 'cypress:run' that executes 'cypress run', which runs all your Cypress tests headlessly (without opening a browser window).
explanations.10: The caret (^) before the version number means npm will install Cypress version 15.19.0 or any newer minor/patch version, but not version 16 or higher.
